name: 公示送達の方法に電子閲覧を追加
summary: 現在、公示送達は掲示して行います。この議案では、公示する内容を不特定多数の人が閲覧できる状態にしたうえで、書面の掲示か、市の事務所に設置した電子計算機の画面での閲覧を選べるようにします。
changes: 公示する内容を不特定多数の人が閲覧できる状態にする
公示送達を書面の掲示、または市の事務所に設置した電子計算機の画面で閲覧できる状態にする
who: 後期高齢者医療に関する公示送達の対象となる人

en.name: Adds computer-screen viewing as a method of service by public notice
en.official: Regarding the Enactment of an Ordinance Partially Amending the Tama City Ordinance Concerning Medical Care for Older Senior Citizens
en.summary: Currently, service by public notice is carried out by posting a notice. This bill would make the contents of the notice available for viewing by an unspecified number of people, and allow the notice to be posted in writing or viewed on a computer screen at a city office.
changes: Make the contents of public notices available for viewing by an unspecified number of people, and allow service by public notice through either posting a written notice or viewing it on a computer screen at a city office
who: People subject to service by public notice concerning medical care for older senior citizens
